title: Universal K-matrix for quantum symmetric pairs
note: arXiv:1507.06276v2 [math.QA], 29 Jan 2016 (v1 2015, per the identifier). No journal reference is printed on the arXiv copy, so none is added. Ingested 2026-11-22 as library/arxiv-1507.06276v2/ from an owner chat upload. Constructs a universal K-matrix for quantum symmetric pair coideal subalgebras B_{c,s} of U_q(g) for g of finite type: it commutes with B_{c,s} and solves the reflection equation in integrable category-O modules (braids in a cylinder, tom Dieck-Haring-Oldenburg). HUMAN-REVIEW: unreviewed.
